title: UzhABB Instituteunun okutuuchulary kesipke bagyt beruu ish-charasyn otkorushtu

blocks.text: UzhABB institutunun okutuuchulary 2025-zhyldyn 14-mayynda Chuy dubanyndagy Alamudun districtunun Grape ayilyndagy Vasiliev atyndagy No. 2-zhalpy bilim beruchu mektebinde zhana Vasilievsk ayilyndagy No. 1 zhalpy bilim beruүchү mektepte bүtүrүүchүlөr arasynda kesipke bagytoo boyuncha ish zhurgүzүshtu. Mynda atalgan mektepterdin 9-11 grades tarynyn buturasynda zholugushuu bolup, 70 butturuүchu katyshty. Alarga K. Karasaev atyndagy BMUnun aldydagy abiturientterdi kabyl aluu companysy zhonүndө keniri maalymat berilip, BMU zhonүndөgү video clip kөrsөtүldү. Buturүүchүlөrdү өzgөchө socialdyk-ekonomikalyk zhana lingvistikalyk bagyttar kyzyktyrary, oshondoy ele studentterdin madaniy zhana koomduk turmushu kyzyktyrary anik boldu. Zholugushuu abdan kyzyktuu otүp, BMUga tapshyruuchulardyn sany arbyn ekendigi anik boldu.
© Mukhtar Choguldurov – Uzgultuksuz zhana distancelyk bilim beruu institutunun director
INDO teachers held a career guidance meeting

On May 14, 2025, INDO teachers visited Vasilyevskaya comprehensive school No. 2 in the village of Vinogradnoye, as well as comprehensive school No. 1 in the village of Vasilyevka, Alamudun district, Chui region. A meeting was held with the organizers and students of grades 9-11. The meeting was attended by 70 graduates who were informed about the upcoming admission campaign of BSU. A video about BSU was shown. Graduates were especially interested in socio-economic and linguistic areas, as well as cultural and social student life. The meeting was held in an atmosphere of interest and expressed a desire to enter BSU.
© Mukhtar Choguldurov – Director of the Institute of Continuous and Distance Education
